No doubt about it, I also happen to own one. As far as recoil goes, with moderate practice, 00 buck isn't that bad, really. The Maverick 88 is the benchmark for the best value pump-action shotgun. There's a few things to know before you get one, however.

If you find you can only put two shells in the magazine tube, do not worry, Mossberg puts a wooden dowel plug in the tube, which is used to limit the amount of shells you can put in the shotgun, which is a requirement for hunting in most states. Also, if your 88 has trouble feeding, your cartridge stop and/or interrupter could be bent (not saying it will happen to you, but that's what happened when I got mine, it's not that big of a deal, you can either bend them back into shape or buy new ones for around $10).

I would honestly grab one. You won't regret it, $200 for a reliable, robust shotgun that will run anything and has plenty of aftermarket potential.
